approach: Static recompilation to C on antbox, an xboxrecomp fork; the game's own Xbox graphics commands drawn with Vulkan
notes: Alpha. The menus and mission 1 work, with saves, replays, English and Japanese. Nobody has finished the game on it yet. Options include the game's own 720p, widescreen, higher internal resolution and anisotropic filtering, on a PC SETTING page in the game's look. Runs at the game's own 30 fps.
